description: List a page of subproperty event filters on a property, including filters that route events to subproperties. Use the returned page token to retrieve subsequent pages.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing subproperty event filters on a property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of resources to return; at most 50 by default, maximum 200.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. Page token received from a previous call to retrieve the next page.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. Resource name of the ordinary property. Format: properties/{property_id}
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: ListSubpropertyEventFiltersRequest

name: list_subproperty_event_filters

FilterClause.description: Filter clause within a subproperty event filter.

filterClauseType.description: Type of filter clause (INCLUDE or EXCLUDE).
filterClauseType.title: Filter Clause Type

FilterClause.title: FilterClause

FilterCondition.description: Individual filter condition for event routing.
FilterCondition.title: FilterCondition

FilterExpression.description: Logical expression for event routing. Contains one of: orGroup, notExpression, or filterCondition.
FilterExpression.title: FilterExpression

ListSubpropertyEventFiltersResponse.description: Response model for listing subproperty event filters.

nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results, if any.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

ListSubpropertyEventFiltersResponse.title: ListSubpropertyEventFiltersResponse

applyToProperty.description: Resource name of the Subproperty using this filter.
applyToProperty.title: Apply To Property

filterClauses.description: Unordered list of filter clauses that define the SubpropertyEventFilter.
filterClauses.title: Filter Clauses
